title: Target-side derived unit germ factorization
statement: For a commutative square g′≫f=f′≫g of schemes and separably closed geometric point t of Y′, put F′=f′_*, G′=g′^*, R=g′_*, H=Γ_X and S=stalk_t. Let b:H→G′⋙F′⋙S be the global-sections image of the underived g′ adjunction unit followed by Γ/Leray for g′, inverse Γ/Leray for f′ and the target globalGerm(t). Let c on a bounded below homotopy complex M be the inverse S localization factorization at F′(G′M), followed by D(S) of the F′ right-derived unit at G′M and D(S) of R(F′) applied to the inverse G′ localization factorization at M. Then the Γ_X right-derived unit at M followed by RΓ_X of the derived g′ adjunction unit, derived Leray for g′ and derivedGlobalGerm(f′,t) equals Qh(mapHomotopyCategoryPlus(b).app M) followed by c. These are the canonical constructions of [def-weil-pbc-derived-global-germ], [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction] and [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

proof.text: Work with abstract additive functors L, R, H, H′, F′, T, S, an exact L left adjoint to R, an exact S, and the two underived Leray identifications e:R⋙H≅H′ and e′:F′⋙T≅H′. Use derivedPlus_unit_app_fac to expand the derived adjunction unit as the localized homotopy adjunction unit, the R derived unit and R of the inverse L localization factor. Move this last factor through the R/H Leray comparison by naturality. Naturality of H's derived unit and rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompIso'_fac replace the preceding composite by H of the homotopy adjunction unit, Qh of e.hom, and H′'s derived unit. Move the inverse L factor through the target germ by naturality.

Expand the target germ using its definition. Cancel the target Leray comparison against its inverse and apply rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompIso'_fac; this replaces H′'s unit followed by inverse Leray with Qh of e′.inv followed by the composite F′/T derived unit. Move the F′ derived unit through the composite of the derived germ and exact-S comparison by naturality. Apply rightDerivedFunctorPlusNatTrans_app and rightDerivedFunctorPlusIsoMapDerivedCategoryPlus_hom_fac. The resulting tail is exactly the three maps defining c.

Combine the four Qh maps by functoriality. Through the faithful inclusion K⁺(A)→K(A), present M as the quotient of a complex K and apply the homotopy adjunction unit formula on quotient objects. All four maps become images of complex maps. Their degree-n components are H(η_Kn), e.hom at L(Kn), e′.inv at L(Kn), and the underived germ at F′(L(Kn)); expansion of b gives exactly these maps, with unitor and associator identity factors. Thus their composite is mapHomotopyCategoryPlus(b).app M. Instantiate the fully proved private abstract lemma with the small-etale functors; the canonical derivedGlobalGerm is definitionally the abstract target germ.

theorem derivedGlobalGerm_unit_fac
    {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (sq : CommSq g' f' f g)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y')
    (M : HomotopyCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    let B := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let F := lowerStar B f
    let F' := lowerStar B f'
    let G := upperStar B g
    let G' := upperStar B g'
    let R := lowerStar B g'
    let H := Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology B
    let S := (pointSmallEtale t).sheafFiber
    let b : H ⟶ G' ⋙ F' ⋙ S :=
      (Functor.leftUnitor H).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction B g').unit H ≫
        (Functor.associator G' R H).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft G' (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso B g').hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft G' (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso B f').inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft G' (Functor.whiskerLeft F' (globalGerm t))
    let c := S.mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh.inv.app
        (F'.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj (G'.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj M)) ≫
      S.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (F'.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app (G'.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj M)) ≫
      S.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map (F'.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
        (G'.mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh.inv.app M))
    H.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app M ≫
        (H.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
          ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction B g').derivedPlus.unit.app
            (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.obj M)) ≫
          (@Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompIso' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
            R H _ _ _ _
            (Functor.preservesInjectiveObjects_of_adjunction_of_preservesMonomorphisms
              (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction B g'))
            (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso B g')).hom.app
              (G'.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.obj M))) ≫
        (derivedGlobalGerm f' t).app
          (G'.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.obj M)) =
      DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.map ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus b).app M) ≫ c
